ai_summary: Action Construction Equipment Limited has scheduled its 32nd Annual General Meeting (AGM) for September 18, 2026, to be held virtually. Key dates include a September 3, 2026 record date for final dividend eligibility and a September 11, 2026 cut-off for e-voting participation. While the closure of share transfer books from September 4-18, 2026 will temporarily restrict transfers, this is a routine corporate announcement outlining standard procedures with no apparent red flags.
